name: agent-app
title: Agent App
description: An agent app's shell: an optional rail of the app's areas (chat, files, settings) at the window's edge, kept while the sidebar is closed, the app's mark at its top, or (railPlacement="sidebar") a bar at the sidebar's foot at every width, as on a phone, with no column; a sidebar (its name and a new conversation, a search row with its keys, then 32px rows of 14px, a project's count or `meta` and a conversation's time at their ends, a conversation's `icon` before its title and its `detail` a second line under it, a project's `hint` after its name, open by default or as the app keeps them, `shown` up to all; SidebarEdge its edge) of projects (the directories conversations start in), flat, each to its page with its count, then the app's conversations (`layout` list, the default), or each opening to its latest conversations, then the conversations in no project (`tree`), or, with `groups` (places projects live, e.g. machines) and its segmented tabs, a collapsible section per group with its projects and conversations, an unavailable one marked, a project showing its conversations' most pressing status in greys by shape (in a tree, while closed); the main area a card on the sidebar's colour, right after the rail while the sidebar is closed or folded; on a touch screen the rail is the desktop's (48px, 32px icons, 44px targets unseen) and the sidebar keeps its own new conversation and search, 28px wider for its rows; under a finger the sidebar's edge is a handle to see (a thin line, 4 by 32px, darker as it is held), dragged without the page scrolling, a tap leaving it open; a header of where the reader is ("agentui / Fix the slow deploy", 13px); the conversation's column of 12 columns of 48px, 752px with 16px each side (AgentAppColumn) and the composer's place under it (AgentAppDock, the messages fading above it), or a new conversation's page (AgentAppStart): its composer already in an AgentAppDock, where the conversation's will be, and the heading centred in the room over it, which shrinks and scrolls first in a short window; the row above the composer where a new conversation's project is picked, optionally in labelled groups (e.g. by the machine they are on), each with its own "No project" and "Add project…", the trigger then naming the group (with one group, no headings and the plain names), gone once it has started; a project's page of all its conversations, with room for the app's own sections; and a resizable panel of the app's beside the main area, the sidebar closing to the rail while it is open, in one card with it split by a line (a conversation's files, or a Browser, whose tabs are then its bar), which can expand over it, and as a sheet or a phone's drawer over the whole window; the app's areas at the sidebar's foot. On a touch screen too narrow for the sidebar beside the conversation's 600px (a tablet upright), a list and its page: the sidebar open at its narrowest between the rail and a conversation of minTouchMainWidth (432px, a large phone's, so from 704px); narrower (an unfolded phone), the sidebar folds to the rail and opens as a sheet over the conversation. On a foldable open as a book, the conversation on one screen and the panel on the other, or with no panel the sidebar pinned open as the first screen; half open as a laptop (tabletop), the composer's dock on the bottom screen. On a phone the header is the sidebar's button, the title and the app's actions at a finger's size, the sidebar is a sheet ending with the app's areas, and the panel a sheet from the bottom. The app gives the data, the addresses and the menus, and routes. With titlebar, a desktop window's bar across the top: back, forward and the sidebar's button past the window's own buttons, the header in it, the rail and a card of the sidebar and main area under it, 8px from the window's end and foot, its corners rounded, dragged by the bar; a panel beside the main area has its bar in the bar's row over it, as wide as it (useAgentAppPanelBar for a content's own, e.g. a Browser's barContainer), the panel's one button (AgentAppPanelTrigger, then the bar's AgentAppPanelClose) at the window's end open or closed; without Window Controls Overlay (a WKWebView's) the app's --agent-app-titlebar-inset and --agent-app-titlebar-height on the root, and agentAppTitlebarControls for a host that drags the window itself. AgentAppSidebarTitle: the sidebar's header as a button (renaming the workspace), its words where a title's are and as heavy, its hover's grey 8px out; a chevron with `chevron`. AgentAppPage `tabs`: above its title, under the way back, 16px over the title (line tabs on a rule), the first tab's word on the page's start line, the title's and the content's. A conversation's `meta` (its facts: where, its branch, its cost, when) stands in columns on a project's page, lined up across its rows (ItemGroup `columns`), its status and buttons after them, `metaAlign` each column's start (words, the default) or end (numbers); on a phone, a line under its title. The pages' and AgentAppConversationList's density="compact": 32px rows, as the sidebar's, without an outline, for a long list. A dialog opened from the panel, open as the window narrows past the panel's room, stays on top and in reach: the panel's sheet or drawer opens once it closes. AgentAppPage's footer stays at the page's foot as it scrolls, on its colour, in its column: e.g. unsaved changes, an Alert with its AlertActions.
